name: Rosazzo

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

terms: Denominazione di Origine Controllata e Garantita, Italy's top tier. Stricter than DOC, and given only to wines that have been DOC for at least seven years.

blurb.text: A white DOCG from Udine province in Friuli-Venezia Giulia. It is at least 50% Friulano, with 20 to 30% Sauvignon, 20 to 30% Pinot Bianco or Chardonnay and up to 10% Ribolla Gialla. The zone covers parts of Corno di Rosazzo, Manzano and San Giovanni al Natisone.
